original_environment_contracts.family_concentration: report sequence and pair counts, top mapped-family fraction of all weight, known-family HHI, unmapped fraction; small or concentrated strata are diagnostic only

pair_level.isolated_pair: neither inward (i+1,j-1) nor outward (i-1,j+1) stacked partner exists
pair_level.junction_pair: closing pairs and member stem-closing pairs of multiloops; order 2, 3, >=4; overlapping definitions are separate environments
pair_level.loop_closure: immediate child-stem count inside a closing pair: 0 hairpin, 1 internal/bulge, >=2 multiloop

pair_span.definition: zero-based inclusive j-i; original pairs retained

paired_ci.sensitivity: family-cluster bootstrap; never treat pairs as independent Bernoulli trials
paired_ci.unit: paired sequence bootstrap on identical IDs and coverage

sequence_level.cluster80: existing cluster_id; singleton/small clusters are diagnostic only
sequence_level.family: unique Rfam14.9 exact full-sequence mapping; unmatched and ambiguous remain separate diagnostic states
sequence_level.source: prefix before first colon in source

original_selection_policy.comparison: same sequences, pairs, coverage, decoding protocol and training budget; paired 95% CI required
original_selection_policy.primary_metric: macro pair-F1 over macro-component-eligible mapped families
original_selection_policy.route_rule: no route decision from VL0 alone or from any diagnostic-only stratum; preserve micro performance and report target-environment retention

population_views.route_condition: only models with exact registered cluster80 Train IDs

population_views.id_semantics: source-population IDs only; this is not a cleaned subset
source-population IDs only; this is not a cleaned subset

remaining_gaps: complete official RiNALMo pretraining manifest and historical nt snapshot remain UNCHECKED
known-source EXACT/HOMOLOGY/NOT_DETECTED_UNKNOWN is a bounded audit; UNKNOWN is not clean
HOMOLOGY and NOT_DETECTED_UNKNOWN cluster-dev strata have zero mapped families and fail family gates
cross-TR1c/CHANRG 80% homology, structure similarity and temporal lineage remain UNCHECKED
per-record experimental lineage, modified-parent mapping and PDB/mmCIF agreement remain UNCHECKED
margin dual training and independent margin evaluation are not inputs to this registry and cannot alter route selection

route_panels.scope: route selection only under v1 environment thresholds and paired-comparison contract; NOT_DETECTED_UNKNOWN is not clean

route_panels.future_condition: complete gradient-update set exactly equals family-panel Train IDs and excluded IDs never enter training
none: raw CHANRG Train/Validation 80% homology makes this panel non-route-eligible
complete gradient-update set exactly equals CHANRG matched-clean Train IDs; cross-source leakage and unchecked layers must be separately reported

scientific_scope: additive exposure sensitivity and final reporting only; no new training, inference, homology search or route selection

paired_comparison_contract.sensitivity: family-cluster bootstrap; never treat pairs as independent Bernoulli trials
paired_comparison_contract.unit: paired sequence bootstrap on identical IDs and coverage
